title: Better Auth and team-shared chats
what: Authenticate the Web UI with Better Auth and let every authenticated team member view Slack/GitHub/Discord/Webhook conversations. Preserve one Session DO per thread and persist the shared directory.

acceptance.text: Let different users view the same thread history and execution state
Retain exactly one conversation per thread
Do not expand tool authority through shared viewing
Prefer Void's Better Auth integration and keep service secrets out of browsers
